task.title: Home shows today's planned meals
task.description:
Owner decision (2026-11-18): Home shows today's plan; the hand-set 'current recipe' stays as a fallback.

Wanted:
- Home shows today's planned meals in order, each with its type; Cook meals link to the recipe, plain names say no recipe is attached, Leftovers name their source.
- When nothing is planned today, Home shows the hand-set current recipe as it does now, plus a link to plan the day.
- A link from Home to the planner on today.

Notes: 'today' is the user's local date. Must include breakfast once 'Planner: add a breakfast slot' lands.
